title: Retain validation after partial output failure

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Build mcp-server and open the demo with bridge, verify and the Editor-only project-command fixture. Use one persistent MCP session. Preserve existing dirty scenes/settings and snapshot only disposable fixture files before mutation.

steps.title: Retain validation after partial output failure
steps.payload: Describe project.demo.partial_output. Start once with invalidJson:true and once with false, each with a distinct key and gate enforce. Observe status and wait to terminal. Inspect invocation.txt and terminal mutation/gate for both runs; repeat terminal status.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Both jobs fail after a possible write and retain checkpoint/validation.
Invalid JSON is not success; failure does not promise rollback or trigger replay.

reset.note: Wait for terminal execution before restoring saved fixture bytes under Assets/_ValidationSuite/ProjectCommands. Preserve pre-existing files, scene changes and settings. Never restart an uncertain operation for cleanup.
